title.zh: GLM-5.3 Workers AI 模型中的跨请求 KV 缓存暴露（155 条响应）
title.en: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model (155 responses)

current_state.zh: Cloudflare Workers AI GLM-5.3 的用户隔离泄露已修复，SGLang 相关缓存管理缺陷已修补并建议升级至 v0.5.22；未发现恶意利用，其他 Workers AI 模型未受影响。
current_state.en: The Cloudflare Workers AI GLM-5.3 user-isolation leak has been fixed; related SGLang cache-management defects were patched with a recommendation to upgrade to v0.5.22; no malicious exploitation was found and other Workers AI models were unaffected.

updates.title_zh: GLM-5.3 Workers AI 模型中的跨请求 KV 缓存暴露（155 条响应）
updates.title_en: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model (155 responses)
updates.what_changed_zh: Cloudflare 发布了对 Workers AI 一个缺陷的根因分析：GLM-5.3 的跨请求 KV 缓存未在用户之间正确隔离，可能导致会话内存重叠，问题追溯至预填充缓存容量不匹配，已通过将该模型下线修复。
updates.what_changed_en: Cloudflare published a root-cause analysis of a Workers AI bug in which GLM-5.3's cross-request KV cache was not properly isolated between users, allowing potential overlap of session memory, traced to a prefill cache capacity mismatch and remediated by pulling the model from serving.

updates.title_zh: Cloudflare AI用户隔离失效：GPU缓存不够竟照常回答，155条回复泄露其他客户内容
updates.title_en: Cloudflare AI用户隔离失效：GPU缓存不够竟照常回答，155条回复泄露其他客户内容
updates.what_changed_zh: 披露了另一类 SGLang 缓存重用漏洞、其修复版本 v0.5.22，以及实际泄露已于 9 月 9 日修复、未发现恶意利用且其他 Workers AI 模型未受影响。
updates.what_changed_en: Disclosed a separate SGLang cache-reuse bug, its fix version v0.5.22, and that the actual leak was fixed on September 9, with no evidence of malicious exploitation and other Workers AI models unaffected.
updates.current_state_zh: Cloudflare Workers AI GLM-5.3 的用户隔离泄露已修复，SGLang 相关缓存管理缺陷已修补并建议升级至 v0.5.22；未发现恶意利用，其他 Workers AI 模型未受影响。
updates.current_state_en: The Cloudflare Workers AI GLM-5.3 user-isolation leak has been fixed; related SGLang cache-management defects were patched with a recommendation to upgrade to v0.5.22; no malicious exploitation was found and other Workers AI models were unaffected.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Cloudflare disclosed that a GPU cache capacity mismatch in its Workers AI GLM-5.3 deployment let 155 over-length requests leak other customers' cached content, alongside a related SGLang cache-reuse bug that the SGLang team has since patched.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Cloudflare disclosed that a GPU cache capacity mismatch in its Workers AI GLM-5.3 deployment let 155 over-length requests leak other customers' cached content, alongside a related SGLang cache-reuse bug that the SGLang team has since patched.
